summary: More than most people, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you read people and care on instinct and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.
body: More than most people, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you read people and care on instinct and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity. Emotions may move quickly here. Care, anger, and instinct can sit close together, which can make reactions feel immediate and hard to separate.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need, or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it, then turn on whoever is closest.
integration: Let emotional needs and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
